narr: A midlevel shortwave moved through the area producing storms with severe criteria hail and wind gusts. In Council Bluffs, 2 to 3 inches of rain fell over about an hour which led to a flash flood warning being issued. Flash flooding washed through basement apartments, swept up cars, and heaved pavement in low-lying areas.
ev: Trained spotter reported 2-4 feet of water over roads.
Public report from mping of street/road flooding; street/road closed; vehicles stranded.
Emergency manager reported several flooded roads in the city. A couple of cars have been stranded.
